literature_notes: All four ledger lines (L1–L4) describe C-terminal fusions to TRPA1 (eGFP, mTagBFP, mCherry, V5-His). The TRPA1 C-terminus (residue 1119) lies within the intracellular domain (topology 957–1119), so none of these constitute extracellular surface tag sites. The N-terminus (residue 1) is also intracellular (topology 1–719). TRPA1 has three extracellular spans: EC1 (741–764, 24 aa), EC2 (825–829, 5 aa, too short), and EC3/pore loop (895–934, 40 aa). No ledger line reports any insertion in any of these extracellular loops or at any extracellular-facing position. Zero extracellular surface tag sites are supported.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal eGFP fusion (via 3×GGGGS linker) after residue 1119 is functional and fluorescent in HEK293T cells, but the C-terminus is intracellular (topology 957–1119), so this is an intracellular tag, not a surface tag.
